svg.content: <mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" type="device"><diagram id="13-content" name="13 · Reel, Series and sharing entities"><mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" page="0" pageWidth="2495.0" pageHeight="1780.0" shadow="0" adaptiveColors="none" scopeDescription="Implemented entities and conceptual associations; database enforcement is stated in the constraint note." schemaConstraints="UML entity model: solid lines are associations; multiplicities describe the named roles, not database integrity. Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ} are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys. UNIQUE(seriesId,episodeNumber) orders episodes. ViewSession PK is (userId,reelId,playbackSessionId). ViewEvent UNIQUE(userId,reelId,playbackSessionId,sequence). Outbox aggregate and playback-session correlation links have no declared FK. series: seriesId; nullable; onDelete SetNull (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); aggregate: aggregateId when aggregateType=REEL (logical) (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); playback session: userId + reelId + playbackSessionId correlation (scalar-ID association; no declared FK) Operational upload/media-attempt lease rows are Content-owned; their publishIntentId/mediaKey and reelId/attemptId links are logical correlations, not declared Prisma FKs. ReelSubtitleTrack UNIQUE(reelId, language); reel: reelId cascade delete (declared SQL FK); sourceHash ties a track to the transcript it was translated from. ReelRerankExposure PK is (feedSessionId, reelId); its userId and reelId are logical scalar IDs joined to ReelViewEvent, not declared FKs. Reel.searchTags is a normalized copy of tags kept by a database trigger and indexed with GIN."><root><mxCell id="0" style="fontFamily=Helvetica;" value="" /><mxCell id="1" parent="0" A Reel belongs optionally to a Series and can have shares, share links, view events, subtitle tracks and outbox events. Upload and media leases protect publishing; rerank exposure rows measure the feed experiment." vertex="1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=15;fontColor=#1F2937;align=left;verticalAlign=top;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="51.0" y="104.0" width="1268" height="50" /></mxCell><mxCell id="notes" value="UNIQUE(userId, publishIntentId): one logical Reel per owner / publish action.<br>Fingerprint rejects conflicting intent reuse; different intent permits the same source video.<br>Upload adoption uses owner + publishIntentId + mediaKey. Attempt leases correlate by reelId / attemptId.<br>These lease correlations are logical scalar IDs, not declared foreign keys.<br>Series deletion sets the optional Reel link to null; declared Reel references cascade. Outbox/session links are logical.<br>Subtitle tracks cascade with their Reel. Rerank exposure rows are experiment measurements keyed by feed session and Reel; they are not part of the Reel aggregate." vertex="1" parent="1" div.div: The tables behind Reels. A Reel belongs optionally to a Series and can have shares, share links, view events, subtitle tracks and outbox events. Upload and media leases protect publishing; rerank exposure rows measure the feed experiment.

text.tspan: The tables behind Reels. A Reel belongs optionally to a Series and can have shares, share links, view events, subtitle tracks and outbox events. Upload and media leases protect publishing;
rerank exposure rows measure the feed experiment.

div.div:
UNIQUE(userId, publishIntentId): one logical Reel per owner / publish action.
Fingerprint rejects conflicting intent reuse; different intent permits the same source video.
Upload adoption uses owner + publishIntentId + mediaKey. Attempt leases correlate by reelId / attemptId.
These lease correlations are logical scalar IDs, not declared foreign keys.
Series deletion sets the optional Reel link to null; declared Reel references cascade. Outbox/session links are logical.
Subtitle tracks cascade with their Reel. Rerank exposure rows are experiment measurements keyed by feed session and Reel; they are not part of the Reel aggregate.
